scope: Additive capability proof; original family scenarios/identities are retained and remain owned by TST-39/40, integration by TST-45. Prior case lists identify consuming contracts, not replacement equivalence.

cases.assertion_purpose: Exact bytes/modes/base/scope, read-only check, scratch separation, NUL paths and strict unsupported requests.
cases.negative_control: Independent literals/raw files; corrupt bytes/hash/scope/base/mode and reject unsafe paths/envelopes.

cases.assertion_purpose: Public export/record/verify/recover, durable evidence and independent reconstruction.
cases.negative_control: Omit reconstruction effect; corrupt stored artifact, change remote and restore positives. Wrong reconstructed binary bytes have a separate reviewed golden; real Checkpoint rejects byte inequality and restored application passes.

cases.assertion_purpose: Public apply with phase consent, unrelated index/files, conflicts and scoped commit.
cases.negative_control: Corrupt artifact/path; omit mode/stage; mutate unrelated bytes and commit hook; restored positive passes. A nonzero partial effect retains already-written binary/addition and untouched later paths. A deliberate check-time write fails the real review/consent snapshot before application, then restored check succeeds.

cases.assertion_purpose: Real delivery parent, path, staged/committed byte and mode verification, distinct remote state.
cases.negative_control: Corrupt manifest hash/mode/path/base and restore; no provider publication.

cases.assertion_purpose: Additive TST-36 review regression: empty-file staging after intent, index replacement/removal and independent scratch state. No legacy replacement equivalence claimed.
cases.negative_control: Omitted stage/reset/update-index/read-tree effects retain pending intent; restoring full staging exposes the exact addition.
